## HubSpot Deal Pipeline Watchdog (template)

### How it works

The workflow contains no nodes, so there is no execution flow to analyze. No triggers, processing steps, or outputs are currently defined on the canvas.

### Setup steps

- Add a trigger node to start the workflow.
- Add and connect processing or output nodes as needed.
- Configure any required credentials after adding service-specific nodes.

### Customization

Build the workflow by adding nodes for the desired trigger, data processing, integrations, and final output.

nodeGroups.name: Load settings and pipeline
nodeGroups.description: Reads your settings, the HubSpot portal, the pipeline stages and deal owners. Stops with a clear message if the pipeline is wrong.

nodeGroups.name: Scan deals and apply rules
nodeGroups.description: Pulls every deal in the pipeline, checks the hygiene rules and finds clients ready for expansion.

nodeGroups.name: Ask Jev for a decision
nodeGroups.description: Adds the latest note, asks TypeSafe Jev for risk and fix (rules as fallback) and builds the review form.

nodeGroups.name: Review and apply
nodeGroups.description: Emails the review form, waits for your choices, applies only the ticked fixes and reports the result.
